snippet.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember – Reveal Trailer | XBOX Games Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
KOEI TECMO America and developer Team NINJA reveals that their dark Three Kingdoms action RPG, Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember, is currently in development and will release Early 2027.

In this long-awaited sequel to Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty, which has surpassed over 5 million players worldwide, players must master the evolved Chinese martial arts and conquer battlefields of the Three Kingdoms overrun by monstrous demons alongside renowned heroes who left their mark on history.

Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title and with XBOX Game Pass.
